description: This file contains implementation of two functions related to HTTP proxy control: HttpSpoCbcReplyHeaders and HttpSpoCbcReplyBody. Both functions currently do not perform any logic and simply return a constant process mode indicating relay.

methods.name: ULONG HttpSpoCbcReplyHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Handles proxy behavior control when reply headers are received. Currently returns a relay mode constant.

methods.name: ULONG HttpSpoCbcReplyBody(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Handles proxy behavior control when reply body is received. Currently returns a relay mode constant.
